notes: 0.23.1 — nothing is unfindable, and a tap is a tap. Settings › ☷ All features (searchable index of every view, plate, gesture, card, setting and command, one-tap jump; also in the view-dial menu and the palette). Restored: ⏮ ⏭ and speed (tap the clock to pin them), Layers › ◫ Depth, Timeline labelled 'book of events', 15 palette commands. Wheel Iris: a tap no longer opens it (even during a heavy frame), and a hold anywhere — even near the hub — shows the zoomed band at full contrast. 3D sky: a tap during a heavy frame no longer jumps a telescope rung. Palette 'voyag' finds Voyager 1 again.

apk.notes: 0.22: a calmer screen — layers tucked into one Layers button, Show and Arrange moved into Settings, fewer buttons at rest. Settings › Look & layout: Calm, Standard and Analyst looks, save your own, with live text size, density, glass, motion and layout per posture. Every card now works the same way: a trail, a back button and Next suggestions (learned on this device only; 'interest reset' forgets them). Tap a star in the 3D sky to open its catalog card. The catalog brings 3,674 credited stories from many cultures (each with its licence), plus Explain: how names like Tuesday travelled, step by step with sources. Planets show their real reflected colours; Lilly's colours are an opt-in tradition lens.
